scope: B07bd original 1647/1659 historical CLXXXI married merchant, source-to-future-test coverage audit only

domains.acceptable_independent_human_measurement: voluntary documented legal marriage count and observation/censoring window
domains.problems: age cohort censoring, cultural law variation, divorce/remarriage policy, incomplete lifetimes

domains.candidate_outcome_type: age at first recorded marriage, censored if unmarried
domains.acceptable_independent_human_measurement: documented legal first-marriage date against verified birth date
domains.problems: book's threshold is not an exact year prediction, different epoch life expectancy, uncertain merchant birth time

domains.candidate_outcome_type: clearly predefined, voluntary and privacy-respecting relationship count
domains.acceptable_independent_human_measurement: consented self-report with operational definition, not marriage register
domains.problems: ambiguity of sweetheart, privacy, recall errors, value judgment and underreporting

domains.source_1647_claim: first-wife complexion and facial blemish; second-wife mole on forehead near left eye
domains.candidate_outcome_type: predefined marker/visible attribute with observer consent
domains.acceptable_independent_human_measurement: independent blinded observer ratings where consented, not retrospective astrologer fitting
domains.problems: multiple traits, ethnic variance, missing consent, observer disagreement, age changes

domains.source_1647_claim: first wife east/south of merchant birth, second wife far west yet English
domains.candidate_outcome_type: great-circle compass bearing and geographic distance
domains.acceptable_independent_human_measurement: independently documented birth geocoordinates of both partners
domains.problems: original birthplace unknown, meaning of live vs born uncertain, historical political shire boundaries, bearing target must be frozen

domains.source_1647_claim: one or more wives brings inheritance or estate with resistance and delay
domains.candidate_outcome_type: binary event + timing window + amount with independent records
domains.acceptable_independent_human_measurement: voluntary financial records corroborating receipt and contest
domains.problems: loss of privacy and historic property rights, vague source time 'three months or Terms' MUST NOT be silently treated as precise
